snippet.title: Minos - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Minos gets a new trailer and a release date announcement. Watch the latest Minos trailer for this upcoming maze-building roguelite strategy game to see gameplay, traps, and more. Minos is a maze-building roguelite where you, the Minotaur, must defend your sanctuary from bloodthirsty adventurers. Design and re-design deadly labyrinths, set traps, and turn every brave fool into your next victim. Minos will be available on PC via Steam on April 9, 2026.
